item.title: No Heat Wave in Kenya-KMD Explains Why It’s So Hot Right Now

item.title: Kindiki Responds Over Claims Linking His Staff to Church Attack
item.description: Kindiki was forced to respond after Gachagua blamed the government for the church attack, claiming it was carried out by a 'killer squad' of rogue police officers.

item.title: TSC Gives Way Forward After Teacher Killed in Al-Shabaab Attack
item.description: Besides TSC's intervention, the National Police Service has also launched a manhunt for the suspects in the attack, which also left the area chief dead.

item.title: Govt to Deploy Mobile Units to Flush Nairobi Sewers
item.description: The programme, announced in March 2025, will see the government commit Ksh50 billion to regenerate Nairobi River and expand its corridor.

item.title: National Research Fund Announces Grants of Up to Ksh2 Million
item.description: The government agency is offering Ksh500,000 to Kenyans pursueing masters studies as part of the programme, with PhD students receiving millions.

item.title: NCA Issues 2-Week Ultimatum to Contractors in Construction Sector
item.description: The directive comes amid concerns over widespread non-compliance among contractors, which is linked to the recent surge in collapses of buildings in the country.

item.title: Inside Govt’s Plan to Woo China as Beijing Cuts Lending to Africa
item.description: China is increasingly being seen as reassessing how it manages its financial engagement with African countries, as years of heavy lending give way to a more cautious approach.

item.title: Govt Agency Explains Reasons for Prolonged Delays in ID Processing
item.description: Unfortunately, it is not the first time such an incident has been reported during ID processing, resulting in widespread delays and disruption of services.

item.title: Govt Begins Major Upgrade of Ageing Power Grid to Curb Disruptions
item.description: Once operational, the Kilifi and Malindi substations are expected to improve voltage stability, reduce outages, and strengthen the national grid's overall resilience
